jobs.description: WHY JOIN ALO? Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life. OVERVIEW The Director of Asset Protection & Safety International, based out of London, leads ALO’s enterprise protection strategy across international retail markets, ensuring operational integrity, the safety of our people and guests, and the protection of company assets. This leader combines operational discipline, innovation, and mindful leadership to protect both performance and brand experience across diverse regulatory, cultural, and risk environments. The Director is responsible for developing, standardizing, and scaling a comprehensive international retail protection program across the UK, Europe, and APAC. This role integrates operational risk management, safety governance, investigations, and resilience into a cohesive strategy that positions ALO’s Asset Protection & Safety organization as a global center of excellence for protection and prevention. This role will report into the Sr. Director Asset Protection & Safety This leader is both visionary and practical, using data, technology, and human insight to anticipate emerging risks and create scalable solutions that sustain trust, profitability, and operational excellence across international markets. The role partners across Operations, People & Culture, Legal, Finance, IT, Facilities, and Supply Chain to ensure ALO’s protection and safety programs evolve ahead of industry trends while remaining compliant with local laws and cultural expectations. jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer COO
jobs.description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers. Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs. What you will do: Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028 Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel Who you are: A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale –

jobs.title: Senior Controller (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We’re Appinio - the real-time market research partner that supports global (and local) brands to make better consumer-facing decisions. Driven by our mission to deliver rigorous, rapid research in a refreshingly human way, we give businesses real answers from real people in minutes, not weeks. Location: Germany | Remote Department: Finance & Legal Employment Type: Permanent | Full Time As our Senior Controller you’ll: Establish a global controlling function to bridge historical accounting with forward-looking financial planning, ensuring multi-entity legal compliance, budget adherence, and variance analysis across DACH, US, UK, FR, and ES.  Reporting directly to our CFO, you will own our numbers end-to-end and directly influence Appinio’s growth, executive decision-making, and financial team efficiency. What you’ll be doing Lead actual vs. budget variance analysis across DACH, FR, ES, UK, US, HQ Oversee GM1, GM2, and GM3 gross margin analysis and maintain robust bookings-to-revenue bridges Develop and maintain monthly rolling P&L forecasts, personnel cost models, and commission reconciliations Establish pre-close reviews, rigorous financial controls, and global entity consolidation in LucaNet and NetSuite Partner with department leads and executive stakeholders to challenge budget adherence and drive strategic financial insights Note: we ll send you the full job description by email once you move forward in the interview process. About you 🎯 Life at Appinio is fast-paced, collaborative, and powered by people who bring high ambition without the ego. We value transparency, radical candour, and a real builder s mindset. If you thrive on taking ownership, solving complex problems, and creating real impact, you’ll fit right in. Here’s what we’d love you to bring to the table: Must Have: 6+ years of experience in financial controlling or FP&A roles within fast-paced scale-up or tech environments Strong foundation in German GAAP (HGB) accounting standards

jobs.title: Traumpraktikum mit Perspektive: Werde Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d)!
jobs.description: TenMedia ist ein erfolgreiches Softwareunternehmen im Herzen Berlins. Wir sind seit über 14 Jahren auf den Betrieb und die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware spezialisiert. Wir suchen ab sofort einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) im Bereich Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung. Wir glauben an die Stärke und das Potenzial unseres Teams und sind stets bemüht, dass Beste aus uns herauszuholen. Als Praktikant wirst du Teil dieses Teams. Dabei folgst du unserem strukturierten Ausbildungsplan, der darauf ausgerichtet ist, dich innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum Profi zu machen. Neben dem Programmieren stehen auch Tools und Prozesse wie Microsoft DevOps, Scrum und Git im Fokus. Sobald du dich sattelfest fühlst, erhältst du erste Einblicke in echte Projekte und kannst diese erkunden und kleinere Tasks umsetzen, frei von Termindruck und Deadlines. We use our profits to fund research on the most important problems in AI Safety and Alignment. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. Whether you’re an independent researcher, an engineer, or an academic, AE is a place to make real impact on the single most important problem of our time. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Dann werde Teil unseres Capital Markets Teams und begleite führende Finanzinstitute bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Murex-Landschaften. Wir suchen insbesondere Persönlichkeiten mit einem technisch-funktionalen Hintergrund, die Business Analyse, Lösungsdesign und Systemumsetzung miteinander verbinden. Deine Aufgaben Du begleitest anspruchsvolle Transformations- und Implementierungsprojekte rund um die Murex MX.3 Plattform bei führenden Banken und Finanzdienstleistern. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France. jobs.title: Senior Media Relations Manager
jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! jobs.description: Warum roadsurfer? jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. jobs.title: PhD Researcher – Video Understanding & VLMs
jobs.description: About Almetra We build vision-language models that understand what happens on real factory floors. Cameras on 20+ production lines stream video into our models, which turn every step (assembling, screwing, inspecting) into structured data several times per second. Customers use it to see where time gets lost and how to improve their processes. Your role You’ll do your PhD with us from day one, working closely with Sascha, our Head of ML (VLM), on research problems that come straight from our product. Your research runs on real industrial video at a scale few academic labs have. The PhD is co-supervised by a university professor, and you’ll be enrolled at a partner university. What you’ll work on Video understanding with VLMs: action recognition, temporal grounding and long-video reasoning on factory footage Making models robust in the real world: occlusions, unusual viewpoints, new stations and products with little labelled data Turning research results into improvements in our production models Publishing at top venues (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) together with our ML team What you bring Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a closely related field, with a focus on computer vision or multimodal learning (finished or finishing by early-2027) Solid deep learning foundations and hands-on PyTorch Experience with computer vision, video or multimodal models (thesis, projects or internships) Curiosity about real-world problems, not only benchmarks Fluent English Nice to have First publications or a strong thesis in vision-language, video understanding or multimodal learning Experience with open VLMs (e.g. Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA) or video models (e.g. VideoMAE, ViViT) Training on GPU clusters (DDP / FSDP) Why a PhD with us A full-time, paid PhD position in Berlin Mentoring from our Head of ML plus academic co-supervision Unique real-world video data and the compute to use it Your research reaches a real product, not just a paper What we offer E

jobs.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. jobs.title: Head of Cybersecurity
jobs.description: About Us KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions. We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset. At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success. Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way. Job Description Key Responsibilities 1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap. Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment. Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions. Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001. Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates. Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations. Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice. 2. jobs.description: Onze Missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang dilakukan Perseroan yaitu dengan memperkuat tata kelola keberlanjutan terutama di bidang kesehatan, keselamatan, keamanan dan pelestarian lingkungan serta mendorong pemerataan kesejahteraan sosial di masyarakat sekitar proyek. Laporan Keberlanjutan Tahun 2019 dikembangkan dengan tema: Mengutamakan Keberlanjutan sebagai Cara untuk Terus Bertumbuh.
